Notes: The Fire School doorway (Forged in Fire, DS-ACAD-C01-003: Go to the Fire School, DS_School_Fire, and use the forge). The school's own doorway is the volume 'Teleport location 1' (at -3598, 3081, beside the FromFireSchool landing at -3386, 3077); SpiralDB's capture of the live game has that volume as the dragon flight to Dragon's Roost, and Niduus walked into it on 2026-11-22 18:38 CT and was flown away instead of going into the school. The Exit below sends that doorway into the Fire School's Start, and the school's own exit brings you back out here. An extra press-X door (DS_Door_Regular_01, template 126830) stood at -3430, 3078 from 2026-11-22 17:28 CT; it stood loose in the room (Niduus 2026-11-22 22:24 CT: 'weird walls'), and the doorway does the job by itself, so it was taken out.
